name: Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant® American Express® Card

localized_names.en: Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant® American Express® Card

apr.notes: Current APRs were not available from the official card page static content at verification time; see American Express for current Rates and Fees.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees from American Express when using the Card on purchases abroad.

base_rate.description: 2X points on all other eligible purchases

categories.label: Eligible purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy

rewards.redemption_notes: Marriott Bonvoy points can be redeemed for Marriott Bonvoy stays and other travel options; terms apply.

benefits.title: $300 Brilliant Dining Credit
benefits.description: Each calendar year, get up to $300, up to $25 per month, in statement credits for eligible restaurant purchases worldwide made on the Card.

benefits.title: Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant Free Night Award
benefits.description: Receive 1 Free Night Award every year after the Card renewal month for one night with a redemption level at or under 85,000 Marriott Bonvoy points at participating hotels.

benefits.title: Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status, including eligible room upgrades when available and a 50% Bonus Points on stays benefit.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees from American Express when using the Card on purchases abroad.

benefits.title: Brilliant Earned Choice Award
benefits.description: Each calendar year after spending $60,000 on eligible purchases, the Card Member is eligible to select one Brilliant Earned Choice Award benefit.

benefits.title: $100 Marriott Bonvoy Property Credit
benefits.description: Receive up to a $100 property credit for qualifying charges at The Ritz-Carlton or St. Regis when booking direct using a special rate for a 2-night minimum stay.

benefits.title: Fee Credit for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck
benefits.description: Receive either a $120 statement credit for Global Entry or up to $85 for TSA PreCheck through an official enrollment provider; only one credit is given in a 4-year period.

benefits.title: 25 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: Each calendar year, receive 25 Elite Night Credits toward the next level of Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant American Express Card Elite status.

benefits.title: Priority Pass
benefits.description: Enroll in Priority Pass with an unlimited number of visits to over 1,300 airport lounges in over 130 countries.

benefits.title: Premium Internet Access
benefits.description: Receive free in-room premium Internet access; booking requirements apply.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for damage to or theft of a rental vehicle in a covered territory when the eligible Card is used to reserve and pay for the entire rental and the rental company's collision damage waiver is declined.

benefits.title: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen baggage when the entire fare for a common carrier vehicle ticket is purchased on an eligible Card.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: If a round trip is purchased entirely with an eligible Card and a covered reason cancels or interrupts the trip, coverage can reimburse non-refundable expenses up to $10,000 per trip and up to $20,000 per eligible Card per 12 consecutive month period.

benefits.title: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: If a round trip is paid for entirely with an eligible Card and a covered reason delays the trip more than 6 hours, coverage can reimburse certain additional expenses up to $500 per trip, with a maximum of 2 claims per eligible Card per 12 consecutive month period.

benefits.title: Return Protection
benefits.description: Eligible purchases may be returned to American Express if the seller will not take them back up to 90 days from the date of purchase, subject to limits and terms.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Purchase Protection is listed as an included Card benefit; terms, conditions, and limitations apply.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Extended Warranty is listed as an included Card benefit; terms, conditions, and limitations apply.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement for repair or replacement costs following damage or theft, up to $800 per claim with a limit of 2 approved claims per 12-month period, when the eligible wireless bill requirements are met; a $50 deductible applies.

lounge_access.notes: Enrollment required; Amex describes an unlimited number of Priority Pass visits.
